# DLP / Data Security

Primary sources:
- Microsoft Purview: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-learn-about-dlp
- Broadcom Symantec DLP KB: https://knowledge.broadcom.com/
- Forcepoint DLP: https://help.forcepoint.com/
- Netskope DLP: https://docs.netskope.com/

Model:
- incident/event semantics;
- source/destination/channel;
- policy/rule;
- sensitive data classification;
- user/device;
- action;
- evidence;
- export mechanism;
- retention/privacy.

Do not expose matched sensitive content unnecessarily.
